metadata.chunk_title: Where to apply + Micro-credential Learner Fee Subsidy 2026: 80% Funding Available

facts.value: one subsidised course per semester
short, flexible and industry-relevant courses
to help learners upskill, reskill and progress professionally in a rapidly evolving workforce
You must first find and register for your micro-credential on https://springboardcourses.ie/
In 2-5 working days, you will receive an email which will invite you to apply directly on University of Limerick's website.
Please check your spam regularly to make sure you do not miss this email.
Your application will be reviewed, and if successful, you will receive a subsidised offer from University of Limerick. This offer is strictly subject to you meeting the eligibility criteria.
We recommend reviewing your eligibility on MicroCreds.ie before applying.
There may also be a limited number of fee-paying places available on your desired course. Students who are self-financing may have the option to receive funding from four other sources.

facts.value: In many instances, your employer may refund you the cost of your course as you complete each semester. You should discuss this with your HR or training department. Your employer may be eligible to pay your fees on your behalf and receive government funding to do so.
